name: Lalaire de Falamore
source:
A spoiled young adult who has finally gotten her own estate. She has longed to have her own maid despite her mother telling her not to.

When the maid Moniva Uhumani comes into her life, inexplicably naked and in chains, Lalaire is forced to confront her own sexual feelings for the maid and her repressed homosexuality.
